project.name: Jizza :: devices (the Jizza Agent app on people's computers and phones)
project.description: The agent gateway: pairing and signing in devices, the Jizza Agent Protocol over WebSocket and HTTPS polling, the device action catalog, and the command broker that sends workflow steps and agent tool calls to a device and brings the result back. Every app (Windows, Mac, Ubuntu, Android, iPhone) speaks the same protocol, so nothing here knows about a platform beyond the push service that wakes a phone.
